buyer: ChrysCapital, Tata Capital Healthcare Fund III
oneLine: Linux Laboratories raises $70 million via primary and secondary transactions with full exit for Tata Capital Healthcare Fund II.

sources.title: Linux Laboratories raises $70 mn led by ChrysCapital and Tata Capital
ChrysCapital to take minority stake in Linux laboratories

synopsis: Linux Laboratories Pvt. Ltd., a Chennai-based domestic formulations company founded in 2007, has raised $70 million through primary capital and secondary transactions led by ChrysCapital and Tata Capital Healthcare Fund III. The deal provides a full exit for Tata Capital Healthcare Fund II, which generated about 4x returns, while Tata Capital Healthcare Fund III reinvested. ChrysCapital acquired a significant minority stake in the company. The transaction was advised by Avendus. Proceeds will support Linux's next growth phase, including core speciality expansion, adjacent therapeutic areas, brand acquisitions, and R&D capabilities.
